### 1. 🏆 **Alphavima**
**Website:** alphavima.com
Alphavima delivers certified data warehouse consulting for mid-size and enterprise businesses in Hobart, Tasmania.

Their Microsoft-certified engineers build end-to-end data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and OneLake — covering every stage from raw data ingestion to business-ready analytics reports.

They implement Microsoft Fabric as a unified analytics platform for Hobart businesses — setting up OneLake as a central data repository, configuring Fabric workspaces, and connecting operational data sources through Fabric Data Factory pipelines, with implementations delivering a single, governed platform covering data ingestion, transformation, warehousing, and Power BI reporting.
Alphavima is a Microsoft Solutions Partner with 20+ years of experience in ERP, CRM, and cloud data engineering.
